items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I've worked a few gigs with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, he would always be around the club... Oh, I actually thought he was a big-time gambler. Because he was around the Rhythm Club, where they gambled. Most of the time they had a big game goin' in there. And he would always be around, and I figured he was just another gambler hangin' around. Because he was dressed up all the time. He was very neat, you know.
But he was a good trumpet player, too. I've worked a few gigs with him. A very good trumpet player.
Yeah, they had good trumpet players in that band.
